question: According to the right-hand thumb rule, if the thumb points in the direction of current, then the fingers show:
solution:
The correct answer is __**direction of magnetic field lines**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Right-Hand Thumb Rule**, also known as **Maxwell’s Corkscrew Rule**, is used to determine the direction of the **magnetic field** associated with a current-carrying **straight conductor**.
 
• According to this rule, if you imagine holding a current-carrying wire in your **right hand** such that your **thumb** points in the direction of the **electric current**, then your **fingers** will wrap around the conductor in the **direction of the magnetic field lines**. ***Hence, statement 4 is correct.***
 
• The magnetic field produced by a straight wire forms **concentric circles** centered on the wire and lying in the plane perpendicular to the wire.
